title: 第7章 神腿震京城，御剑诀
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
轰隆隆——
雷云滚滚，夜空还是下雨，雨势越来越大。
龙起观三弟子孟秋霜执剑拦在鬼目邪王前方，雨水浸湿她的道袍，虽为女子，但她秀美的脸上毫无惧色。
周围楼宇间的其他龙起观弟子全都紧张的望着鬼目邪王，瑟瑟发抖，不敢出手。
鬼目邪王站在原地，没有前进，他也没有看向孟秋霜，而是盯着孟秋霜后面的夜空，在一处楼顶上有一道身影正望着他。
“没想到龙起观除了清虚老儿还有另外一位高手，原来目标就是你。”
鬼目邪王阴恻恻的笑道，孟秋霜蹙眉，不明白对方的意思。
孟秋霜冷声道：“魔头，你屠戮我观弟子，待我师父回来，定饶不过你，而且这里是京城，我已派遣弟子前去通报衙门，这京城乃天罗地网，你是逃不了的。”
鬼目邪王无视她，笑道：“阁下为何还不出手？为何还不逃？”
孟秋霜这才明白过来，对方根本没有盯着她，她转头看去，身后有楼房，她看不到百丈外的身影，周围的弟子也都软弱，这魔头说的绝顶高手是谁？
“听你的意思，你是冲着我来的，莫非先前的刺杀也是你安排的？”
姜长生的声音回荡在夜空之下，让人难辨声音的来源方向。
听到是姜长生的声音，孟秋霜与一众弟子都愣住，他们自然记得姜长生的声音，不过姜长生是绝顶高手？
鬼目邪王阴笑道：“哦？还有一次刺杀？看来是失败了，不过这一次你死定了。”
他纵身跃起，落在孟秋霜身后的阁楼顶上，一众弟子连忙汇合，退到龙起观大门前，他们放眼看去，终于瞧见姜长生的身影。
姜长生站在明心殿的屋檐上，从远处看去，看不清他的真容，只见他身形笔直，雷云夜空之下，散发着一种难言的强大气势。
“长生师弟……”
孟秋霜喃喃自语，握紧手中的剑。
姜长生望着鬼目邪王，眼神冰冷，杀心已起。
“对方的真气虽不及我的一半，但比师父强得多，看样子也是身经百战，我不能大意，必须全力以赴。”

姜长生心中想到，他开始调动体内真气，道袍随之呼呼鼓动。
鬼目邪王快速冲向姜长生，在屋檐上跳跃，双方迅速逼近，这一幕看得龙起观弟子们心里紧张极了。
如此邪魔，长生能抵挡吗？
孟秋霜与一众弟子担忧的想到。
鬼目邪王纵身跃起，体内真气灌入右掌之中，他的笑容是那么的残忍，眼神之中满是兴奋之色。
“小子，死吧！”
夜色之下，雷电交加，双方的身影被照亮。
当双方相距不到五丈时，姜长生突然动了。
他以鬼目邪王难以捕捉的速度跃起，一腿飞踢而去，身形如鬼魅，他的腿落在鬼目邪王的瞳孔之中，竟产生残影，好似有数十腿同时向着鬼目邪王袭来。
姜长生在半空中踢中鬼目邪王的胸膛，伴随着清脆的骨折声，真气顺着他的右脚爆发，鬼目邪王直接被踹飞出去。
“怎么可能……”
鬼目邪王瞪大眼睛，面露难以置信之色，鲜血止不住的从嘴中喷出，在夜空中留下一条血箭，只见他掠过一座座阁楼，从弟子们头顶飞过，越过山崖，坠向山脚，消失于云雾之中。
孟秋霜与一众弟子瞠目结舌，不敢相信自己的眼睛。
龙起观山脚下，大量狱卒、官兵赶来，张天忍也提着长枪跑来，在左手火把的照耀下，能看到他的脖子通红。
“确定是这个方向？”
一名将军皱眉问道，语气困惑。
张天忍点头道：“没错，就是这个方向。”
将军迟疑道：“这里可是龙……”
话还未说完，上方传来风声，惊得他们下意识扭头看去，一道身影从天而降，砸在龙起观山脚下的台阶上，砸得碎石激飞，血洒一地。
士兵们被惊到，连忙围上去。

“是鬼目……邪王……他死了！”
一名狱卒震惊的叫道，引得张天忍与将军赶上去查看，只见鬼目邪王躺在石阶上，四肢出现令人不舒服的扭曲，其胸膛塌陷，隐约可见森然白骨，他死不瞑目，仿佛见到了世上最可怕的东西，满眼的惊惧。
张天忍动容，抬头望向前方的山，夜色下，雷云滚滚，龙起山显得那么的神秘。
将军检查完鬼目邪王的伤势，沉声道：“他是被一种刚猛至极的脚法活活踢死的，一击毙命，双方的实力差距悬殊。”
实力悬殊？
张天忍回过神儿来，回想起鬼目邪王杀出天牢时的场景，他的神色复杂。
房屋内，姜长生回屋，关上房门，他长出一口气。
他既兴奋，又紧张，这是他第一次杀敌，全力以赴，好在没有翻车。
诛杀鬼目邪王后，他被弟子们围住，不过弟子们没有太兴奋，毕竟死了不少弟子，二师兄孟秋河身受重伤，现在龙起观由三师姐孟秋霜主事，孟秋霜让他提前回屋休息，避免又有奸人前来杀他。
这一夜，是龙起观十数年来最惨的一场灾祸，死去的弟子至少有二十位。
姜长生坐在床榻上，他没有自责，他想的是接下来敌人是否还会再来进犯。
【开元十四年，鬼目邪王袭击你，被你诛杀，你度过一场杀祸，获得生存奖励——法术‘御剑诀’】
一条文字浮现在姜长生眼前，他露出笑容，终于不再是武学，而是法术！
他立即开始接受御剑诀的传承。
一夜无眠。
姜长生仍在练功，庭院内有四名弟子在把守，他们都在低声讨论昨晚的事情，姜长生的表现震惊了全观所有人，但也有人在埋怨他，认为是他招来的邪魔。
可姜长生也是孤儿，他们也无法断言，只能凭借鬼目邪王的话去猜测。
姜长生听力远超凡人，自然听闻到这些言论，但他不在意，他可不是少年，他本身是活了两世的成年人，这一世，他只想尽可能的活下去，没功夫为他人的死而担忧。
况且，武林门派落在京城内，怎会少得了劫难？
姜长生安心练功，没有剑，他练不得御剑诀，所以还是以道法自然功为主。

一直等到陈礼前来拜访，他的练功方才被打断，陈礼不止是一人前来，随行还有一人。
“这位是刑部的尚书大人，杨尚书，此来是为调查鬼目邪王之事，鬼目邪王不止杀害了龙起观弟子，也杀了数位狱卒，此事已经惊动朝廷，陛下震怒，下令彻查此事。”
陈礼介绍道，姜长生一听，拱手行礼。
在大景朝，尚书之位算得上官位的第二级，比刑部尚书权力大的人，找不出十人来。
杨尚书打量着姜长生，眼中有些异色，他开口问道：“你可认得鬼目邪王？就是昨晚袭击龙起观的恶徒，听说还是被你所杀。”
姜长生回答道：“回禀尚书大人，长生自幼是孤儿，一直待在龙起观，除了陈状元与四皇子殿下，不认得山下任何一人。”
杨尚书面无表情道：“那就说说你所看到的一切。”
姜长生如实回答，杨尚书记下后便转身离去，屋内只剩下陈礼与姜长生。
“可以啊，你的武功这么强？连鬼目邪王都能打死，听说他是被你一脚踹下山，活活摔死的？”
陈礼不再伪装严肃，兴奋道。
姜长生的强大让他感觉这些年的投资并非没有意义。
陈礼虽未曾闯荡过江湖，但鬼目邪王在的凶名还是听闻过的，他之前还跟姜长生鬼目邪王被朝廷抓拿的事情。
姜长生摇头道：“他见我年幼，大意了而已。”
陈礼摆手道：“谦虚什么，你那脚法可是让镇守京城的将军都为之惊讶，那鬼目邪王乃真元境之上的高手，按照武林的分级，被称为绝顶高手，这类武夫，真气收放自如，已非凡夫能敌。”
姜长生默默记下。
三流、二流、一流、真元境、绝顶高手！
道法自然功第三层已然能轻松击杀绝顶高手，修仙与习武的差距真是够大的。
陈礼又说了一下案件的情况，天牢乃京城重地，竟然被死囚逃出，皇帝颜面无光，负责看守鬼目邪王的狱卒已经被下令处斩，还要继续调查天牢各级人员，这也是刑部尚书为何亲自前来的原因，要是没有调查好，他尚书的位置可能不保。
尚书之地位何等高，换做其他朝代，哪能那么容易倒下，但在大景朝不同，大多数重臣都是开朝功勋，皇帝一直想拔掉他们，几乎每年都有大臣更替，六部尚书自然如履薄冰。
“你的身份与底细很简单，清虚道长对每一位弟子的户籍都有上报，你不用多担心，你击杀鬼目邪王必然有功，到时候陛下还得奖励你，说说吧，你想要啥，若是上朝时陛下提起，我也好帮你说话。”陈礼摇晃着茶杯笑道。

他算是春风得意了，一夜过去，全京城的权贵都知道龙起观出了一位年轻的绝顶高手，连威震江湖的鬼目邪王都能一腿踢死，在尚武的大景朝中必然前途无量。
但凡一流之上的高手，皆是心高气傲之辈，陈家也就拉拢到一位绝顶高手，对方还不在京城内，只能有事再传唤，姜长生不同，住在京城，又是孤儿，未必不能拉拢成为陈家人。
content_en:
Rumble——
Thunderclouds were rolling, and it was still raining in the night sky, and the rain was getting heavier and heavier.
Meng Qiu Shuang, the third disciple of Long Qi Guan, held a sword in front of the Ghost Eyed Evil King. The rain soaked her robe. Although she was a woman, there was no fear on her beautiful face.
The other Longqiguan disciples in the surrounding buildings all looked nervously at the Ghost Eyed Evil King, trembling and not daring to take action.
The Ghost Eyed Evil King stood there, not moving forward, nor did he look at Meng Qiu Shuang. Instead, he stared at the night sky behind Meng Qiu Shuang. There was a figure on the roof of a building looking at him.
"I didn't expect that Long Qiguan has another master besides Mr. Qingxu. It turns out that the target is you."
The Ghost Eye Evil King smiled sadly, while Meng Qiu Shuang frowned, not understanding what the other party meant.
Meng Qiu Shuang said in a cold voice: "Demon, you slaughter my disciples. When my master comes back, I will not spare you. Moreover, this is the capital city. I have sent my disciples to inform the Yamen. This capital city is a dragnet and you can't escape."
Ghost Eye Evil King ignored her and said with a smile: "Why haven't you taken action? Why haven't you escaped?"
Only then did Meng Qiu Shuang realize that the other party was not staring at her at all. She turned around and saw that there was a building behind her. She could not see the figure a hundred feet away. The disciples around her were also weak. Who was the top master that the devil was talking about?
"Listen to what you mean, you are here for me. Could it be that you also arranged the previous assassination?"
Jiang Changsheng's voice echoed under the night sky, making it difficult to identify the direction of the sound's source.
Meng Qiu Shuang and the other disciples were stunned when they heard Jiang Changsheng's voice. They naturally remembered Jiang Changsheng's voice, but was Jiang Changsheng a top master?
Ghost Eye Evil King smiled sinisterly and said: "Oh? Another assassination? It seems that it failed, but this time you are dead."
He jumped up and landed on the top of the attic behind Meng Qiu Shuang. A group of disciples quickly gathered and retreated to the gate of Long Qi Temple. They looked around and finally saw Jiang Changsheng's figure.
Jiang Changsheng stood on the eaves of Mingxin Hall. From a distance, his true appearance could not be clearly seen. He could only see his upright figure, exuding an indescribable powerful aura under the thundercloud night sky.
"Junior Brother Changsheng..."
Meng Qiu Shuang murmured to herself, clenching the sword in her hand.
Jiang Changsheng looked at the Ghost Eyed Evil King with cold eyes and murderous intent.
"Although the other party's Qi is not half as strong as mine, it is much stronger than Master. It seems that he has experienced many battles. I cannot be careless and must go all out."
Jiang Changsheng thought in his mind, and he began to mobilize the true energy in his body, and the Taoist robes whirred.
The Ghost Eyed Evil King quickly rushed towards Jiang Changsheng and jumped on the eaves. The two sides quickly approached. This scene made the Long Qiguan disciples extremely nervous.
Can Changsheng resist such an evil spirit?
Meng Qiu Shuang and the other disciples thought worriedly.
The Ghost Eyed Evil King jumped up and poured his true energy into his right palm. His smile was so cruel and his eyes were full of excitement.
"Boy, die!"
Under the night, there was thunder and lightning, and the figures of both sides were illuminated.
When the two sides were less than five feet apart, Jiang Changsheng suddenly moved.
He jumped up at a speed that Ghost Eyes Evil King could not catch, and kicked away with one leg. He looked like a ghost. His leg landed in the pupils of Ghost Eyes Evil King, creating an afterimage, as if dozens of legs were attacking Ghost Eyes Evil King at the same time.
Jiang Changsheng kicked Guimu Evil King in the chest in mid-air. With the crisp sound of fractures, his true energy exploded along his right foot, and Guimu Evil King was kicked away directly.
"How is it possible..."
The Ghost Eyed Evil King's eyes widened with an expression of disbelief on his face. Blood spurted out from his mouth uncontrollably, leaving a blood arrow in the night sky. He was seen passing through the lofts, flying over the heads of his disciples, crossing the cliff, falling to the foot of the mountain, and disappearing in the clouds and mist.
Meng Qiu Shuang and the other disciples were dumbfounded and couldn't believe their eyes.
At the foot of Longqiguan Mountain, a large number of jailers, officers and soldiers came. Zhang Tianren also ran up with a long gun. Under the light of the torch in his left hand, he could seeuntil his neck was red.
"Are you sure this is the direction?"
One general asked with a frown and a confused tone.
Zhang Tianren nodded and said, "Yes, that's the direction."
The general hesitated and said: "This is a dragon..."
Before they finished speaking, there was a sound of wind coming from above. They were so startled that they subconsciously turned their heads to look. A figure fell from the sky and hit the steps at the foot of Longqiguan Mountain. The gravel flew away and blood spilled all over the ground.
The soldiers were frightened and hurriedly gathered around.
"It's Guimu...the evil king...he's dead!"
A jailer shouted in shock, which led Zhang Tianren and the general to rush over to check. They saw the Ghost Eyed Evil King lying on the stone steps, his limbs were uncomfortable and twisted, his chest was collapsed, and his bones were vaguely visible. He refused to close his eyes, as if he had seen the most terrifying thing in the world, his eyes full of fear.
Zhang Tianren was moved and looked up at the mountain in front of him. Under the night, with thunderclouds rolling in, Longqi Mountain looked so mysterious.
After checking the injuries of Ghost Eye Evil King, the general said solemnly: "He was kicked to death by an extremely violent kick. He was killed with one blow. There is a huge disparity in strength between the two sides."
Great disparity in strength?
Zhang Tianren came back to his senses and recalled the scene when Ghost Eye Evil King broke out of the prison. His expression was complicated.
Inside the house, Jiang Changsheng returned to the house, closed the door, and let out a sigh of relief.
He was both excited and nervous. This was his first time killing an enemy and he went all out. Fortunately, he didn't overturn.
After killing Queen Guimuxie, he was surrounded by his disciples, but the disciples were not too excited. After all, many disciples died. The second senior brother Meng Qiuhe was seriously injured. Now the third senior sister Meng Qiu Shuang is in charge of Longqi Temple. Meng Qiu Shuang asked him to go back to the house to rest early to avoid another traitor coming to kill him.
This night was the worst disaster in Longqi Temple in more than ten years. At least twenty disciples died.
Jiang Changsheng sat on the bed. He did not blame himself. He was thinking about whether the enemy would attack again.
[In the fourteenth year of Kaiyuan, the Ghost Eyed Evil King attacked you and was killed by you. You survived the killing and received a survival reward - the spell 'Sword Control Technique']
A text appeared in front of Jiang Changsheng's eyes, and he smiled. Finally, it was no longer martial arts, but magic!
He immediately began to accept the inheritance of sword control skills.
Sleepless night.
Jiang Changsheng was still practicing, and there were four disciples guarding the courtyard. They were all discussing what happened last night in low voices. Jiang Changsheng's performance shocked everyone in the audience, but some people were complaining about him, thinking that he had attracted the evil spirits.
But Jiang Changsheng was also an orphan, so they couldn't tell for sure and could only guess based on the words of Ghost Eye Evil King.
Jiang Changsheng's hearing was far beyond ordinary people, so he naturally heard these remarks, but he didn't care. He was not a teenager. He was an adult who had lived two lives. In this life, he just wanted to live as long as possible and had no time to worry about the deaths of others.
Besides, if the martial arts sect falls in the capital, how can it avoid disaster?
Jiang Changsheng practiced his martial arts with peace of mind. Without a sword, he couldn't practice sword control skills, so he still focused on Taoist natural martial arts.
His practice was interrupted until Chen Li came to visit. Chen Li was not the only one to come, but there was also another person accompanying him.
"This is Lord Shangshu of the Ministry of Punishments, Shangshu Yang. He is here to investigate the matter of King Guimu. Evil King not only killed the disciples of Longqiguan, but also killed several jailers. This matter has alarmed the imperial court. His Majesty was furious and ordered a thorough investigation into the matter."
Chen Li introduced, and upon hearing this, Jiang Changsheng raised his hands and saluted.
In the Da Jing Dynasty, the position of Shangshu was regarded as the second level of official position. There were not ten people with more power than the Shangshu of the Ministry of Punishment.
Yang Shangshu looked at Jiang Changsheng with a strange look in his eyes. He asked, "Do you recognize the Evil King Guimu? He was the villain who attacked Long Qiguan last night. I heard he was killed by you."
Jiang Changsheng replied: "Reporting to Lord Shangshu, Changsheng has been an orphan since he was a child. He has been staying at Longqi Temple. Except for Chen Zhuangyuan and His Royal Highness the Fourth Prince, he does not recognize anyone in the mountain."
YangThe minister said expressionlessly: "Then tell me what you saw."
Jiang Changsheng answered truthfully, and after Secretary Yang Shang finished speaking, he turned and left, leaving only Chen Li and Jiang Changsheng in the room.
"Okay, your martial arts is so strong? You can even kill the Ghost Eye Evil King. I heard that you kicked him down the mountain and threw him to death?"
Chen Li stopped pretending to be serious and said excitedly.
Jiang Changsheng's strength made him feel that his investments over the years were not meaningless.
Although Chen Li had never been in the world, he had heard of the evil reputation of King Guimu Evil. He had previously told Jiang Changsheng that King Guimu Evil was arrested by the court.
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and said, "He saw that I was young and was just careless."
Chen Li waved his hand and said: "Why are you being modest? Your footwork surprised the generals guarding the capital. The Ghost Eyed Evil King is a master above the True Yuan Realm. According to the classification of martial arts, he is called a top master. This kind of martial artist can freely release and redistribute his true energy and is invincible to ordinary people."
Jiang Changsheng silently wrote it down.
Third-rate, second-rate, first-rate, true element realm, top master!
The third level of Taoist Natural Skills can already easily kill top masters. The gap between cultivating immortals and practicing martial arts is really big.
Chen Li went on to talk about the circumstances of the case. The Tianlao was an important place in the capital, but a prisoner on death row had escaped. The emperor was disgraced, and the jailer responsible for guarding the Ghost Eye Evil King had been ordered to be executed. The investigation of the personnel at all levels in the Tianlao continued. This is why the Minister of Punishment came in person. If the investigation was not done well, his position as Minister might not be guaranteed.
How high the status of the minister is, how could it be so easy to fall in other dynasties, but it was different in the Jing Dynasty. Most of the important ministers had meritorious service at the beginning of the dynasty. The emperor always wanted to remove them. There were replacements of ministers almost every year, so the six ministers were naturally walking on thin ice.
"Your identity and details are very simple. Taoist Master Qingxu has reported the household registration of every disciple. You don't have to worry too much. You will definitely have merit in killing the Ghost Eye Evil King. His Majesty will reward you when the time comes. Tell me what you want. If His Majesty mentions it when you go to court, I can help you." Chen Li shook his teacup and smiled.
He was so proud that after one night, all the dignitaries in the capital knew that Long Qi had discovered a young master who could even kick the powerful Ghost Eye Evil King to death. He must have a bright future in the martial arts of the Great Jing Dynasty.
All masters above the first rate are arrogant and arrogant, so the Chen family has managed to win over a top master. The master is not yet in the capital, so he can only summon him if necessary. Jiang Changsheng is different. He lives in the capital and is an orphan, so he may not be unable to win over him and become the Chen family.
